response.title: Keep entity totals correct when SQL joins multiply rows
response.body:
Owner: estate-c945953fdeb7 / product_execution_next. Root will derive a separate questions-only authority before any authored answer, explanation or worked guide is disclosed.

## Learner outcome

A SQL learner can already inspect one parent/child join in the received foundations course. This separate original lesson asks what each joined row represents when two independent child collections are joined, why repeated rows change aggregate totals, how entity identity differs from an equal numeric value, and what changes when each child is first grouped to one row per parent.

The deliverable is twelve fixed fictional questions, a worked reading guide, and a plain SQL worksheet. All tables, SQL, option identities, output ordering and type conventions will be sealed before independent answers. A general-policy question will explicitly distinguish a rule that follows from declared keys from an equality that happens only in the small fixture. No real ledger, user database, performance recommendation or measured learning benefit is claimed.

## Exact source and ownership fence

Current main `ec07bf3989132130759e5c00c6cb02eef19709d3`, tree `a839b6877bf2824f134443829d1ce62e1bd79e50`, contains 2,933 complete leaves. The full tree has no governing AGENTS file. Only these three new maintained paths are reserved:

- `courses/sql-join-grain.json`
- `courses/sql-join-grain.md`
- `courses/sql-join-grain.sql`

Evidence is confined to `docs/receiving/sql-join-grain-c945953fdeb7/**`.

The existing foundations guide `7036315770d281dab1782e4af3bf4921a4a4dea1` and all twelve course items `e03736a410aed36404b1cb0cf251c6d91c93b64d` were read in full. They cover duplicate rows, NULL, grouping and a single child relation, without the new two-child aggregation cases. The unchanged native course parser is `f0f8a4b234489c2388f427633f548d56c6ed4c03`.

Bounded current intake received all 274 earlier all-state issue/PR bodies and 53 recent central comments; exact multiplication/preaggregation/SUM(DISTINCT)/join-grain patterns found no matching claim. A fresh created-issue window through #275 and fresh main check still show no conflict. This is bounded public coordination evidence, not a global owner census or native lease.

SQL foundations #22, transactions #84, window functions #213, functional dependencies #222, foreign keys #225, recursive SQL #236, conflict serializability #247 and membership/absence #257 retain their scopes. Existing learner, importer, course catalog, notes, authoring, strict UTF-8 picker and combined-output owners retain all shared source. This change adds no CLI, explorer, builder, validator, catalog entry, README hook, dependency or workflow.

## Questions, authority and runtime boundary

Primary language references are SQLite's [SELECT processing](https://www.sqlite.org/lang_select.html) and [aggregate functions](https://www.sqlite.org/lang_aggfunc.html). The language target is SQLite, with the previously recorded SQLite 3.50.4 semantics as an explicit source target, not a new runtime qualification. All integer results stay small, all key and NULL policies are stated, and every multirow query declares a complete ordering. No dialect-neutral result, implicit storage order or physical query-plan claim is made.

Before answer exposure, the original questions-only packet will fix every schema/row/query, all four option positions, exact result columns and semantic types, and the precise quantifier of the general-policy question. Authored answers and guide will be sealed privately with honest drafting/seal timestamps. Root's later independent solution will be a separate actual record. No SQL, parser, worksheet, browser or learner invocation has occurred.

A later runtime or consumer proposal requires its own exact source/input/resource review and release. The Mac remains UNKNOWN/offline, and another owner's proposed ThinkPad intake is source-only. This reservation allocates no host, interpreter, filesystem stage or native interval.

## Actions boundary

All five current tracked workflow bodies were fully read and match the current source tree. Their events are main-push and/or pull_request; there is no issue/comment subscriber. The separately observed managed Pages main-run hazard remains preserved in the earlier exact record `56b5c3111c9f47b5fff9e6952d615161fff38dc0`; it is not generalized into a claim about every branch.

This issue is ordinary nontriggering source coordination. No ref, branch, PR, main, Pages setting, workflow, Actions execution, installation or deployment is authorized or performed. Root retains any final source publication.

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  receive-handout:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 8
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4, inherited project pin
      - name: Require cached Node 22 and an installed system browser
        id: native
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          HANDOUT_NODE_VERSION=
          for HANDOUT_NODE_DIR in "${RUNNER_TOOL_CACHE}/node"/22.*; do
            if [[ -x "${HANDOUT_NODE_DIR}/x64/bin/node" && -f "${HANDOUT_NODE_DIR}/x64.complete" ]]; then
              HANDOUT_NODE_VERSION="${HANDOUT_NODE_DIR##*/}"
            fi
          done
          [[ -n "${HANDOUT_NODE_VERSION}" ]] || { echo "A complete cached Node 22 is required; no runtime will be installed."; exit 1; }
          printf 'node=%s\n' "${HANDOUT_NODE_VERSION}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
          HANDOUT_BROWSER=
          for HANDOUT_BROWSER_NAME in google-chrome google-chrome-stable chromium chromium-browser; do
            if command -v "${HANDOUT_BROWSER_NAME}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
              HANDOUT_BROWSER="$(command -v "${HANDOUT_BROWSER_NAME}")"
              break
            fi
          done
          [[ -n "${HANDOUT_BROWSER}" ]] || { echo "An installed Chrome/Chromium is required; no browser will be installed."; exit 1; }
          printf 'browser=%s\n' "${HANDOUT_BROWSER}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
          "${HANDOUT_BROWSER}" --version
          command -v python3
          if command -v pdftotext >/dev/null 2>&1; then pdftotext -v; else echo "pdftotext unavailable; PDF artifacts require separate direct inspection."; fi
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4, inherited project pin
        with:
          node-version: ${{ steps.native.outputs.node }}
      - name: Install and identify the standard CJK print font
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install --yes --no-install-recommends fonts-noto-cjk
          dpkg-query -W -f='${binary:Package} ${Version}\n' fonts-noto-cjk
          command -v fc-match
          HANDOUT_JP_FONT_FAMILY="$(fc-match --format='%{family}\n' 'sans-serif:lang=ja')"
          HANDOUT_JP_FONT_FILE="$(fc-match --format='%{file}\n' 'sans-serif:lang=ja')"
          printf 'Japanese font family: %s\nJapanese font file: %s\n' "${HANDOUT_JP_FONT_FAMILY}" "${HANDOUT_JP_FONT_FILE}"
          [[ "${HANDOUT_JP_FONT_FAMILY}" == *"Noto Sans CJK JP"* ]]
          [[ -f "${HANDOUT_JP_FONT_FILE}" ]]
          dpkg-query -S -- "${HANDOUT_JP_FONT_FILE}"
          sha256sum -- "${HANDOUT_JP_FONT_FILE}"
      - name: Receive actual studio, file selection, separate downloads and print artifacts
        run: node tools/check_course_handout_browser.mjs --browser "${{ steps.native.outputs.browser }}" --output "${RUNNER_TEMP}/course-handout-receiving"
      - name: Verify the direct-open teacher page matches its modular sources
        run: python3 tools/make_handout.py --check
      - name: Preserve bounded original browser and print artifacts
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4, verified from the official tag
        with:
          name: course-handout-receiving-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/course-handout-receiving
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14
          compression-level: 6
